records.text: Nova Mini units may be submitted for replacement within 14 days of delivery. Effective 2026-01-01. Current general Nova Mini replacement rule except where a narrower current channel rule applies. Sets the general replacement-request window at 14 days. General product-operations replacement rule for Nova Mini units.

Nova Mini units purchased through the Education channel may be submitted for replacement within 21 days of delivery. Effective 2026-07-01. Current Education-channel scoped rule. Sets a 21-day replacement window for Education-channel Nova Mini purchases while leaving R1 current for other channels. Specific current product-operations replacement rule for Education-channel Nova Mini units.

Beginning 2026-09-01, Education-channel replacement requests must include the institutional order number. Effective 2026-09-01. Current Education-channel documentation rule. Adds a required request field but does not set replacement-window duration. Authoritative product-operations rule for Education-channel replacement documentation only.
